_instructions: Manual SERP review per priority keyword. Update quarterly (competitor audit) or when ResearchAgent runs keyword-gap refresh.

topSerpPatterns: Full-service provider service pages (Merestone, Ansera, IDEKO, Event Solutions) with Fortune 500 proof and retention stats
Multi-city agency pages with embedded case-study galleries (Stoelt Productions)
Industry directories and listicles (EPD, DesignRush, Cvent Top 50) occupy 2–4 organic slots
Nationwide positioning with named metro hubs (LA, NYC, Miami, Austin) without deep geo content
keywords.recommendedLcpAngle: Hub owns head term via /nationwide-event-production. Differentiate with planner checklists, venue production guides, and case-study proof — not another generic 'full-service nationwide' brochure. Emphasize show-caller accountability and multi-city consistency (CitiView/Meeting Tomorrow angle) with LCP insider technical detail.
keywords.notes: Oct 2026 SERP: Google rewards dedicated service landing pages with social proof, not blogs. Directories are entrenched — do not chase listicle rankings. Competitors lead with client logos, retention %, and end-to-end scope lists. LCP gap: live hub exists but lacks competitor-level case-study density and downloadable RFP/run-of-show assets on the page itself.

topSerpPatterns: Corporate AV service pages with FAQ blocks (Meeting Tomorrow, Catalyst, Tallen)

Hybrid/virtual capability sections standard on every top result
keywords.recommendedLcpAngle: /feeds/av-production is live — refresh with FAQ mirroring buyer questions (in-house AV, multi-city, booking lead time). Add case-study module and link capture blogs (hybrid checklist, RF mic planning) as proof of planner expertise. Avoid gear-catalog tone; lead with accountable production team model.
keywords.notes: Oct 2026 SERP: Top results all position as 'the team accountable for the outcome, not just equipment' (Prime AV, Meeting Tomorrow). FAQ schema common. Competitors own equipment narrative; LCP should own rehearsal/show-caller and general-session execution narrative. Blog cluster supports long-tail but service page must carry commercial intent.

Cannibalization risk with hub — keep distinct H1 and keyword focus per registry.
